europe_now.title: Russian Hybrid Threats and Security
europe_now.summary: EU officials have warned of a dangerous escalation in Russian hybrid threats across the continent. Meanwhile, French leadership addressed intelligence sharing regarding potential drone security concerns.

europe_now.title: Attack at Polish Abbey
europe_now.summary: A fatal knife attack at a Polish abbey left a priest dead and multiple individuals injured. Ukrainian and Polish leadership condemned the violent incident.

sources.headline: Zelensky condemns knife attack by Ukrainian at Polish abbey that left priest dead and others injured

top_stories.title: European Union Migration and Asylum Policy
top_stories.summary: European institutions and member states are increasingly engaging in external deportation agreements with African nations. This trend reflects a broader international push toward financing third-party countries to manage migrant populations.

sources.headline: Deporting humans becomes big business, as Brussels and Washington race to pay African countries to take them

top_stories.title: Switzerland Neutrality and Sanctions
top_stories.summary: Voters in Switzerland are weighing the future of the nation's traditional neutrality stance. The outcome of this vote directly impacts the country's alignment with broader Western sanctions against Russia.

sources.headline: Switzerland’s neutrality vote puts Russia sanctions on the line
